data_objects.name: dated_evaluation_records
data_objects.meaning: Dated evaluation records combining several binary target fields, numeric online fields, PAC and AFD score features, encoded business categories, weights, and status flags.

variables.name: recall_pt
variables.meaning: Recall/reference calendar date encoded as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: main_score
variables.meaning: Integer-valued main score or score code; its ordering and calibration are not documented.

variables.name: target1
variables.meaning: First binary 0.0/1.0 target indicator.

variables.name: target2
variables.meaning: Second binary 0.0/1.0 target indicator.

variables.name: evaluate_target
variables.meaning: Binary 0.0/1.0 evaluation-target indicator.

variables.name: mh_on
variables.meaning: Nullable numeric field named mh_on; the abbreviation and unit are not defined.

variables.name: hr_on
variables.meaning: Nullable continuous numeric field named hr_on; negative values are valid observations.

variables.name: d_on
variables.meaning: Nullable nonnegative numeric field named d_on on a wide scale.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: pac_v2_x0 … pac_v2_x27
variables.meaning: Twenty-eight indexed PAC v2 numeric features on a score-like scale.

structure.description: Each row is one evaluation record. apply_date and recall_pt are daily date fields, month is the monthly grouping key, encoded biz fields are categorical, and hy_weight supplies a row weight.

uncertainties: The source does not define mh_on, hr_on, d_on, the binary target relationships, score calibration, or category-code dictionaries.
The meaning of -1 in x1 through x9 is not stated; it may be a sentinel or a valid coded value.
annotation_notes: Blank mh_on, hr_on, and d_on cells are missing and should not be replaced with zero implicitly.
The PAC columns are grouped as a regular indexed feature family; the nine x fields and nine named AFD subscores are listed separately.
